# Stop Biting
> An app that uses on-device AI (MediaPipe/WebAssembly) to detect nail biting (onychophagia) in real-time via webcam, then sounds an alarm. 100% private — no camera data ever leaves your device. Available as a native desktop app for Mac and Windows, and as a web app (PWA).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://stopbiting.today/): Landing page — download, features, pricing, privacy commitment
- [Blog](https://stopbiting.today/blog): Science-backed articles on nail biting, habit reversal, and onychophagia
- [Privacy Policy](https://stopbiting.today/privacy): Data handling and privacy commitment
- [Contact](https://stopbiting.today/#contact): Contact form for support and feedback

## Key facts

- Nail biting (onychophagia) affects 20–30% of adults and up to 45% of adolescents
- Habit Reversal Training (HRT) reduces biting frequency by 70–90% in consistent practitioners (Cochrane review, 2012)
- BFRBs (body-focused repetitive behaviors) are classified in the DSM-5 under OCD-related disorders
- Stop Biting uses MediaPipe running in WebAssembly — zero network requests during detection
- Detection works fully offline after initial load; no camera data is transmitted or stored
- The app detects nail biting using hand landmark (21 keypoints) + face mesh (468 landmarks) models
- Free 3-day trial — available for macOS 12+, Windows 10+, and in the browser as a PWA
- On-device AI: camera feed never leaves the device — independently verifiable via network monitoring
